##### Project general facts

Hudayriyat Golf Estates is a prestigious residential development by Modon, set alongside sweeping fairways and serene water channels. This exclusive precinct features a collection of golf mansions, fairway villas, range villas, golf homes, and townhomes with four to six-bedroom layouts. Designed in Andalusian-inspired architecture, the estate offers a distinguished living experience where pristine nature, world-class amenities, and the gentle rhythm of the game come together in perfect balance.

Residents enjoy an exceptional array of amenities woven into the master community. At the heart lies an award-winning championship golf course designed by Lobb + Partners, alongside a country clubhouse, golf academy, spa and wellness centre, sports courts, cycling trails, dining and retail outlets, parks and green spaces, coworking spaces, and a private school. Minutes from Hudayriyat Island's iconic Sports Village, residents also have access to Surf Abu Dhabi, the Velodrome, and the elite High Performance Centre.

Every residence at Hudayriyat Golf Estates is crafted with meticulous attention to detail. Mansions and villas feature expansive layouts across basement, ground, first, and penthouse levels, with spaces dedicated to family living, formal entertaining, gyms, spas, and private offices. Interiors showcase premium finishes, open-plan living areas, and kitchens designed for both show and service. Bedrooms offer generous wardrobes and en-suite bathrooms, while outdoor terraces, pools, and covered pergolas blur the lines between indoor and outdoor living.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Hudayriyat Island, this exceptional location is a destination shaped by duality — where energy and calm, urbanity and sanctuary, discovery and accessibility exist in seamless balance. Set against pristine waters and open skies, the island brings together leisure, sport, wellness, and community in one iconic setting, designed for life to move in a natural state of flow.

The location is distinguished by its effortless connectivity and world-class surroundings. Zayed International Airport, Abu Dhabi Global Market, the Louvre Museum, and Yas Island’s attractions are all within a short drive. The island itself offers a vibrant coastal environment with mangroves, beaches, and cycling trails, while nearby landmarks include the Velodrome, Surf Abu Dhabi, and the High Performance Centre.

For those seeking a residence that embodies prestige, tranquility, and investment potential, Hudayriyat Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of championship golf, waterfront living, and a prime Abu Dhabi address makes it one of the emirate’s most desirable locations. This is a place where life finds its swing — grounded, boundless and effortlessly connected.
